Ava C (ML Eng): Heads-up: running int4-packed bringup for magnet-32k-qa and seeing a reproducible token shuffle when a long prefill ends near a particular byte offset in the packed KV slot. Repro steps below.
Ravi S: Token shuffle meaning tokens repeat/drop or the model emits different tokens compared to fp16?
Ava C (ML Eng): Different tokens after the boundary. Example: fp16 continues: "... 5023,5024,5025,5026" but int4-packed emits "... 5023,5025,5026,5027" — basically a single-token slip downstream. Not catastrophic but fails deterministic evals.
Jun H: Pls paste the exact bench invocation and any env flags.
Ava C (ML Eng): Run:```bash
python -m bench.run --model magnet-32k-int4packed --prefill tests/prefill/28k_paragraphs.txt \
  --context-window 65536 --kv-slot-pad 32 --kv-prefill-stride 128 --quant-format int4-packed --seed 7
```
Ava C (ML Eng): Observed across dev-01 and dev-02 GPU nodes, single-shard and 4-shard configs. Repro ~12/100 runs.
Ravi S: Can you show the earliest divergence token IDs diff?
Ava C (ML Eng): Minimal diff:```diff
- ... 5023,5024,5025,5026,5027
+ ... 5023,5025,5026,5027,5028
```
Ava C (ML Eng): I also dumped the raw packed bytes for the offending KV slot (hex): `fe ab 10 4c 00 00 ff 7a ... 1f` and the unpacked int4 nibbles starting at slot offset 4096 looked shifted by one nibble in failing runs.
Jun H: That sounds like a nibble-alignment bug when computing which 4-bit lane to read after a long prefix. Could be an off-by-one in floor(pos / 2) vs integer division sign issue. Are we using signed arithmetic anywhere in the offset calc?
Ava C (ML Eng): The unpack path uses a signed 32-bit index for historic reasons. I added a quick patch locally to cast to uint32 before the >> 1 and the repro vanished in 30/30 smoke runs.
Ravi S: Nice. Can you try increasing kv-slot-pad to 64 as a temporary mitigation to see if padding hides the misalignment?
Ava C (ML Eng): With `--kv-slot-pad 64` I ran 50 runs, 1/50 repro (much reduced). So padding helps but doesn't fully remove it. Casting to unsigned seems promising.
Ops Bot: infra: dev-02 scheduled maintenance at 2026-04-12T02:10:00Z, long runs might be disrupted.
Ava C (ML Eng): I filed a ticket RDW-8301 and pushed a branch `fix/int4-nibble-index` that forces unsigned arithmetic in the unpack helper and adds a fuzz harness that mutates prefill lengths around power-of-two boundaries. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-8301
Jun H: Can you add a unit that asserts nibble reconstruction equals baseline for a corpus of aligned and misaligned slots? If the fuzz harness fails, it should emit the raw bytes + slot index.
Ava C (ML Eng): Added tests + CI job. CI Bot: bench/fuzz-int4 #457 queued.
Ravi S: If the unsigned cast fixes it, we should also audit memcpy/pack routines that assume alignment and add asserts in debug builds for slot offsets modulo 2/4/8.
Jun H: Agreed. Also add telemetry: when we hit a mismatch during prefill handshake, emit `kv_slot_offset_mod` metric so we can correlate with field failures in staging.
Ava C (ML Eng): Will do. Quick mitigation: PR open to clamp/bounds-check nibble index + add uint casts. Assigning review to @Ravi. If merged, we'll run a 24h nightly of the longprefill corpus.
CI Bot: bench/fuzz-int4 #457 started  running tests.
Ava C (ML Eng): Thanks team  will report back with nightly results, attaching failing run logs and hex dumps in RDW-8301. :eyes:
